title: ML-SHARD-TRUNCATED: BTC/SOL 15m market_raw data.jsonl cut short (151,000 / 64,000 rows vs metadata 175,296 / 175,104)
note: FOUND 2026-10-13 by lane ML-DATA-OFF-TRAINER (trainer diag #17894). market_raw/BTCUSDT/15m/v002/data.jsonl has 151,000 rows (last 2026-02-01T21:45Z) but its metadata.json says row_count 175,296 (generated 00:44Z); SOL has 64,000 rows (last 2023-08-12) vs 175,104; ETH is consistent. The files were rewritten at 05:18Z / 05:42Z, ~4.5 h after the metadata, i.e. a second writer replaced the file with a prefix (round row counts). market_features and forecasts were rebuilt from the cut files, so every BTC/SOL regime unit and regime-head training reads cut data (RQ-20261012-75b2-22: n_test_rows=0). The 05Z hour is the over-subscribed catch-up hour (busy 1.96) -- correlation only, writer NOT identified. NEXT: (a) read journalctl for ict-trainer-catchup / ict-trainer / drift-retrain 05:00-05:45Z for an OOM kill or write error; read scripts/ops/build_trainer_datasets.sh BTC/SOL 15m raw build + any second market_raw writer; (b) repair: rebuild BTC/SOL 15m market_raw (Tier 2: data-mutation job) and add a row_count vs metadata check to ml/datasets/validate.py so the build fails loudly; (c) re-run the withheld units. The exporter already withholds such shards.

observation.what: market_raw BTC/SOL 15m data.jsonl row count equals metadata row_count and last_ts is within 1 day on the trainer; MANIFEST.withheld empty on the next export
